subject: Subprocessor onboarding evidence & timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah.j@riskops.com>
Cc: Northwind Health Procurement <procurement@northwindhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Subprocessor onboarding evidence & timeline

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As discussed, Northwind is running a SIG-lite and wants a short, consumable evidence pack focused on our subprocessor roster, data flows to each subprocessor, and the SOC 2 controls that apply to hosted inference.

Can you confirm the target submission date for the evidence and whether the reviewer needs documentation organized by control families (CC3, CC6, etc.) or by subprocessor? We can deliver a compact ZIP and a short index file.

Proposed timeline:
- Nov 20: submit subprocessor inventory + scoped SOC 2 controls summary
- Nov 22: provide artifact pack (sample contracts, encryption config, KMS flow)
- Nov 24: follow-up call to walk through any gaps

If that works, I'll loop in our compliance team and attach the inventory.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: subprocessor_inventory_v2.xlsx (xlsx stub, 42 KB)
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah.j@riskops.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Northwind Health Procurement <procurement@northwindhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Subprocessor onboarding evidence & timeline

Ben,

Thanks — that timeline is helpful. The reviewer prefers artifacts organized by subprocessor with quick pointers to which SIG/CAIQ questions each artifact addresses (e.g., data residency, encryption at rest, logging access). If you can include a one-page index that maps files to control IDs, that'll speed review.

Two quick clarifications:
1) For the SOC 2 summary, can you indicate the date of the most recent test and whether the scope included Redwood Dedicated and Private deployments?
2) For subprocessors that handle cryptographic keys, we need the KMS provider and whether keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed.

Procurement: do you need a single DocuSign envelope for the attestation, or separate instruments per SOW?

Appreciate the quick turnaround,

Sarah Jennings
RiskOps Manager
Northwind Health
sarah.j@riskops.com

--

Laura, Karthik — forwarding Northwind's ask (below). They want a subprocessor-organized artifact pack and a one-page index mapping each file to SIG/CAIQ control IDs. Key points to handle:
- Confirm SOC 2 last test date and whether Dedicated/Private are in scope
- Provide KMS provider and key ownership for any subprocessor that handles keys
- Produce the small index file that maps artifacts -> control IDs

I've attached the latest inventory (subprocessor_inventory_v2.xlsx) — please review and flag any gaps. Also, add a short note about telemetry (what logs are stored, retention, and who has access).

New timeline from our side to align with their review:
- By EOD today (Nov 20): updated inventory + one-page index (PDF)
- Nov 22: full evidence ZIP sent to Sarah

Ben
